limitations: Exact local spectral criterion at a positive disease-free state of the homogeneous, no-spillover five-state patch model, not global or stochastic establishment. No conclusion on nonlinear stability at the simple-zero boundary. Requires positive excess infected extinction, environmental clearance, and environmental conversion.
title: An absolute movement floor for environmental invasion in a five-state wildlife metapopulation
